title: Our approach to advertising and expanding access to ChatGPT
summary: OpenAI plans to test advertising in the U.S. for ChatGPT’s free and Go tiers to expand affordable access to AI worldwide, while protecting privacy, trust, and answer quality.
body: OpenAI plans to test advertising in the U.S. for ChatGPT’s free and Go tiers to expand affordable access to AI worldwide, while protecting privacy, trust, and answer quality.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布计划在美国市场为ChatGPT的免费版及Go版引入广告测试。此举旨在通过商业化手段降低全球用户获取先进AI服务的门槛，同时承诺在广告投放过程中严格保护用户隐私、维护信任度并确保回答质量。这是OpenAI在平衡商业可持续性与普惠AI愿景方面的重要战略调整。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI引入广告模式以扩大ChatGPT免费及Go层级的覆盖范围，具有重要的商业战略意义。
